definitions.explanation: Informal words or expressions used in everyday speech rather than in formal or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: 「⟦やばい→やばい：04747_yabai⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{俗語|ぞくご}だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{俗語|ぞくご}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{収録|しゅうろく}→収録：08378_shuuroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This dictionary also includes many slang terms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧や⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{俗語|ぞくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: You should avoid using slang in academic papers and business documents.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{俗|ぞく}→俗：24364_zoku⟧ (common, vulgar) + ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word, language). Refers to informal vocabulary that is widely used in spoken language but not considered standard or appropriate for formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {俗語|ぞくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use slang)
- {俗語|ぞくご}⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (slang expression)
- {俗語|ぞくご}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ (slang dictionary)
- ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧{俗語|ぞくご} (youth slang)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スラング — slang (loanword, more casual; often used for English slang specifically)
- ⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧ — spoken language, colloquial language (broader term for informal speech)
- ⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧ — dialect (regional variation, not necessarily informal)
- {隠語|いんご} — jargon, argot (in-group language, more secretive connotation)
